summary: Fastcall dispatcher that runs an indirect callback stored at a1+16, passing a pointer to a local copy of a2; if that callback returns a non-null pointer, it copies the dereferenced result into a local and runs a second callback stored at a1+12, returning its result. Otherwise returns the null result of the first call.

local_names.a1: object holding two callback pointers at +12 and +16
local_names.a2: input value copied to a local and passed by address to the first callback
local_names.v5: local holding a2, passed as the parameter slot to the first callback
local_names.v6: local holding the dereferenced result of the first callback, passed to the second
local_names.v4: second callback pointer read from a1+12

operations.description: Copy the second argument a2 into the local parameter slot v5.
Invoke CallbackCheck with the callback pointer stored at a1+16 and the address of the local slot v5; the returned pointer is stored as result.
Proceed only when the first CallbackCheck returned a non-null result pointer; otherwise return it as-is.
Read the second callback pointer from a1+12 into v4.
Dereference the first callback's result pointer and store the pointed-to word into the local slot v6.
Invoke CallbackCheck a second time with the second callback pointer (a1+12) and the address of local slot v6, returning its result.
Return the null result of the first callback when the guard failed.
Called from sub_5644B0 (0x005644B0), StringComparisonWithConstantDispatch (0x00564530) and AudioMixerSampleGetWithFallback (0x00564580), spanning string-dispatch and audio-mixer fallback paths.
